{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicates_info = {
    'total_unique_patients': len(df['patient_id'].unique()),
    'total_rows': len(df),
    'number_of_duplicate_patients': len(duplicates),
    'duplicate_patients_list': duplicates.index.tolist(),
    'max_sample_seq_per_patient': df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().to_dict()
}

duplicates_info"}
